project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 SPA with Supabase backend (@supabase/supabase-js), @tanstack/react-query v5 for data, react-router-dom v7 routing. pt-BR UI.
build_system: npm (Node v22 via nvm at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin — must prepend to PATH; `npm` is NOT on the default PATH). package-lock.json committed; deps already installed.
test_framework: Vitest + Testing Library. Pure-helper unit tests live in src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts (e.g. src/domain/__tests__/rules.test.ts, src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts). jsdom env, setup in src/test/setup.ts.
build_command: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm run build  (= tsc -b && vite build)
test_command: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm run test  (vitest run). Also npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and npm run lint (eslint .).
verification_instructions: 1) npm run typecheck must pass. 2) npm run lint must stay at 0 errors and must NOT exceed the 6 pre-existing warnings (in Toast.tsx, AuthProvider.tsx, LessonView.tsx, QuestionComponents.tsx, NotebookPage.tsx x2). 3) npm run test must pass (baseline 97 tests). 4) npm run build must emit dist/. Run `npm run format` on changed files to satisfy prettier.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/types/database.ts is GENERATED via `supabase gen types` — DO NOT hand-edit. For schema changes add NEW migrations under supabase/migrations/ (next number is 0017+). Consuming code is written against the intended regenerated shape; keep the build green using the NormalizeDatabase shim in src/types/supabase-compat.ts and documented boundary casts (the codebase already does `as unknown as X` casts at supabase query boundaries). The user will run `supabase gen types` after merge to regenerate database.ts to match new columns.
setup_instructions: Repo cloned at /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen on branch main. Prepend the nvm node path to PATH, then run npm scripts. No network/Supabase instance available — SQL migrations and RLS cannot be exercised in-sandbox (best-effort structural review only, same as prior tasks documented in README).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (npm registry reachable) but NO live Supabase instance in the sandbox: Auth, RLS and SQL domain functions can only be verified by a human against a live DB. SQL migrations are validated structurally only (ordering, idempotency via create-or-replace / add-column-if-not-exists). database.ts cannot be regenerated here (needs `supabase gen types` against a live project), so new columns referenced by TS code must be handled via boundary casts to keep tsc green.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT commit on main (default branch). Create a NEW feature branch off main (e.g. feat/layout-and-course-improvements) and commit all work there. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator does that). Prettier + ESLint configured; keep lint clean (no NEW warnings). Server (SQL functions + RLS) is authoritative for XP/level/PAC/division/medals; the client only mirrors/display-validates (src/domain/). Keep src/domain constants byte-for-byte in sync with SQL. Do NOT rewrite/delete existing migrations; only add new ones. Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Feature-folder architecture under src/features/<feature>/ with an api.ts (react-query hooks over supabase), page/components .tsx, and pure helpers.ts covered by __tests__/*.test.ts. Supabase queries use string select() with FK-named embeds (e.g. creator:profiles!courses_creator_id_fkey(...)) and cast rows `as unknown as RowType`. Domain math mirrored in src/domain/{constants,rules}.ts and asserted against SQL in src/domain/__tests__/rules.test.ts. AppShell wraps all authenticated routes via <Outlet/>. Theme/layout CSS in src/styles/theme.css using CSS vars (--brand-purple, --color-*). Level is already an integer field (profiles.level); only DISPLAY strings prefix it with 'L'.
